description: This file contains a JUnit test class for the ConceptService in the OpenMRS API project. It tests various functionalities related to concepts, concept sources, concept mappings, concept answers, and related entities within the system. The tests verify behavior such as fetching concepts by name, UUID, mapping, saving concepts, concept classes, datatypes, handling of internationalization, and retirement of sources, among others.

classes.name: ConceptServiceTest
